_description: Multi-brand registry of approved migrated pages requiring regression protection. Every shared-asset edit (see Shared-File Inventory in SKILL.md) must be regression-tested against EVERY page in the active brand's 'pages' array before being declared done. Update this file whenever the user approves a page: move its entry from 'inProgress' to 'pages' under the correct brand, and set approvedDate.
_howToFindActiveBrand: Read the in-progress page's URL or the page metadata. The brand key is one of the 9 entries in brand-config.json. For migration work, focus on commercial pharma brands: rinvoq-hcp, skyrizi-hcp, rinvoq-dtc, linzess, venclexta, mavyret.

inProgress.title: Rinvoq HCP — Coverage & Access (dermatology)
inProgress.notes: First page where shared-asset edits regressed an approved page. Pre-edit gate now enforced.

linzess.specialNotes: Hash-based navigation pattern — see abbvie-page-migration skill Linzess section

venclexta.specialNotes: CLL-specific ISI variant; clinical-data-panel block heavy

mavyret.specialNotes: Univers Condensed font; alternative-therapy clauses in ISI

howToUse: 1. Identify the active brand for the current migration (from page URL or page metadata `brand:` value).
2. Before editing ANY file in the Shared-File Inventory (see orchestrator SKILL.md), snapshot every page under `brands.{activeBrand}.pages` at 1440 + 390.
3. After edit, re-snapshot every page in that brand's `pages` array and diff against pre-edit baseline.
4. Any unintended visual change on any page in that brand's `pages` = regression. Revert and reconsider scope.
5. When the user approves the in-progress page, move it from `inProgress` to `pages` under the same brand key. Set approvedDate.

6. Cross-brand caveat: if your edit touches BASE block CSS/JS (which you should escalate, not patch), regression check must run across EVERY brand's pages, not just the active brand's. Brand-only edits stay within their brand's page list.
addingANewBrand: If migration starts for a brand not in this list (e.g. abbvie, botox, rinvoq for corporate/non-commercial work), add the brand key under `brands` with empty `pages` and `inProgress` arrays. The Shared-File Inventory rules in SKILL.md apply identically.
